To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of a real-time operating system in a system-on-chip design can reduce power consumption by 50% and increase performance by 10%.
the use of the MARTE modeling language for the modeling of real-time embedded systems is not only feasible and practical but also beneficial.

(a) the Tolapai embedded platform can be used for real-time embedded applications; (b) the MARTE profile is a good candidate for modeling real-time embedded applications, and (c) the UML profile for MARTE is a good candidate to model real-time embedded applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
modeling and simulation of real-time Tolapati based embedded system using UML MARTE.
modeling the real-time Tolapati based embedded system using the MARTE profile.
the design of a real-time embedded system that is based on Tolapai architecture.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of MARTE in modeling the Tolapai based system is an effective way for the design, development, and implementation of real time systems.
the Tolapai processor is the first Intel processor to be designed for embedded system.
the Tolapai embedded system is the first IA-based SoC that integrates the IA-32 processor, North and South bridges, and integrated Accelerators and Network interface.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed the first MARTE based model for Tolapai processor.
we developed a model for Tolapai based system using MARTE, a UML profile for real-time systems.
we have developed a real-time embedded application using MARTE profile of UML 2.0 and the application has been successfully tested in the Tolapai embedded board.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of MARTE is a viable approach for developing real-time embedded systems, and that the use of the MARTE profile can help in reducing the time and effort required to develop real-time systems.
we can model real-time embedded systems with the help of MARTE and use the model for simulation.
it is possible to model and analyze the real-time properties of Tolapai based systems using the MARTE profile.
